title: Future Opportunity - Fullstack Developer (m/f/d)
company: 7.1 Tech Hub - a ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE company
description: Introduction Sentence We are anticipating the upcoming opening of a Java Backend Engineer w/ AWS within our local tech team in Portugal. Working at the 7.1 Tech Hub is so much more than just a job. Your work with a closely-knit international scrum team. The team consists of highly experienced individuals organized in several agile product teams with deep competences in cutting-edge media technologies, cloud tools, product management, software development and IT operations. We are looking for engineers with “application-owner” mindset, who are excited to take end-to-end responsibility for the systems that they are developing - “you build it, you own it, you run it”. Please note that this application is an expression of interest, as the position is not currently open. It may take time to be contacted, and you will be notified of any updates. What You Can Expect In This Role You are part of engineering culture that emphasizes Clean Code, Test-Driven-Development (TDD) and continuous refactoring. You contribute to creating large software systems that are extendible, and you apply Domain-Driven-Design (DDD), Clean Architecture and various Object-Oriented Enterprise Design Patterns to keep code modular and readable. You interact directly with end-users and work on the full product development lifecycle (from gathering requirements to testing and deployment), to deliver solutions to their business problems with a DevOps mentality. Our tech stack: Java 17, Spring Framework, JUnit, RSocket, TypeScript, Vue.js 3 (Vite, Vuex, Vuetify), Vitest, OpenAPI, MapStruct, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, Nginx. Your Essential Experience And Education You have 4+ years of experience designing and developing large software applications. Must-haves: Java; Spring Framework; Typescript, and either Vue.js/Angular or React.js. Nice-to-haves: Docker; DynamoDB; SQS/SNS; Lambda; Python; AWS; OpenAPI. You have profound experience in building production-quality software in teams and can autonomously tackle complex problems. Experience and knowledge in Agile methodologies. Experience working through the full product development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment. Fluent in English (Portuguese and/ or German language proficiency is a plus). What's in it for you? Exciting Intersection of Entertainment and Tech: Join one of Germany´s leading media companies being at the forefront of digital transformation and world-class technology Compensation: Fair and equal pay I Maximum exempt food allowance (via Coverflex) I Employee discounts/offers I Relocation bonus Personal & Professional Development: Well-defined career progression with personalized skill-building & growth focus I Udemy I Conferences & training budget I Optional German/Portuguese classes I Side project time Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours I Hybrid working model (90 days onsite per year, self-managed) I No dress code I 25 vacation days plus half day on Xmas Office Perks & Amenities: Free parking I Free coffee, tea & fruits I Pet-friendly office I Rooftop lounge with snooker & piano I On premise gym, cafeteria, vending machines & microwaves Wellbeing: Private health insurance (incl. option of family extension at own cost) I Mental health support I Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership Team Spirit: Top Employer according to Teamlyzer | Frequent team events | Regular trips to Germany I Start-up spirit I Supportive, inclusive and open corporate culture, e.g. employee networks like PROUD, Greenteam, fempowerment Closure We are looking forward to your application! Apply within 5 minutes via our job portal. Your profile doesn't fit 100%? No worries, apply anyway! We support your professional & personal development on the job. At Seven.One Tech Hub, part of ProSiebenSat.1 as the home of popular entertainment/infotainment and a leading entertainment and commerce player in the German-speaking region, we make digital entertainment happen! Reaching millions of viewers and users each day is the basis of our success. We develop first-class products and take our technology to the next level every single day. You are looking for an exciting career opportunity in media and e-com, love to work for different branches and products, and become part of a diverse tech community? Join our newly set-up Tech Hub and become a crucial part of our digital future. Company Text Click here to learn more about the ProSiebenSat.1 Group and our diverse portfolio. As a signatory of the Diversity Charter, ProSiebenSat.1 is committed to a working environment free of prejudice and actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities among employees. You have a disability and would like to apply? Then you are very welcome. We know that we are not entirely accessible yet, but we are working on it. Let's talk about how we can eliminate any barrier together and find an individual solution if needed. Although we refer to one gender in the text, all genders may be implied.
